ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the Planned Development Number 131 symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 28-G the area bounded by

A line 13 feet north of the public alley next north of and parallel to West 115th Street; South
Halsted Street; the public alley next west of and parallel to South Halsted Street; the public alley
next north of and parallel to West 115th Street,

to those of a B3-1 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Tet Mig

Ronnie L. Mosley
Alderman, 21° Ward

Common Street Address: 11350 S. Halsted Street
